title: •Antilles Maneuver
caption: •Antilles Maneuver (V)
game_text: For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent’s starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent’s deploy phase, ▼ a Rebel of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship.
lore: As their war with the Empire continued, Rebel pilots learned ways to counter standard Imperial tactics such as the Tallon Roll.
